messages:
alice (support): Heads up — multiple customers reporting 5xx / timeouts from hosted inference endpoints since ~2026-03-15T10:40Z. Primary symptoms: 502 gateway errors and occasional 504s. Customer example: "inference call returns 502 after ~12s". Attaching excerpt from gateway: 

ben (eng-runtime): saw same in our dashboards. Quick grep in logs: 

    gateway: upstream read timeout (110) while reading response from 10.4.2.8:6379 -> returning 502 to client

incident-bot: ALERT: redis-cache-prod.99p-latency > 2s for 5m; evictions spiked; error-rate increased 18% (automated alert rule cache.latency.high)
carmen (eng-sre): Metrics show a big spike in redis command latency and blocked clients around 10:37Z. Memory used hit 98% on two primaries and we saw replica resync activity. Possible OOM/eviction storm or resharding.

david (oncall): paging in. I'm running quick checks against production cache nodes now. If this is blocking, we should enable cache bypass for read path and increase gateway timeouts short-term. @ben can you push a flag?

ben (eng-runtime): on it. Pushing temporary feature-flag to bypass prefix/KV cache for host inference routes: 

    POST /flags/cache.read_through/disable?scope=hosted-inference

Will also bump upstream timeout from 10s -> 20s for the affected route in the gateway config to reduce 502 noise.

alice (support): I've replied to affected customers with a short note that we're investigating and suggested retries/backoff. Sending ETA update in 15m.

carmen (eng-sre): quick debug snippets I ran: 

    # latency check against primary
    redis-cli -h redis-primary-01 latency latest
    # output (trimmed)
    1) 1586099823
    2) 0.004
    3) 0.012
    4) 2.121  <-- spike
    5) 0.006

And tail of redis log: 

    10:37:12.345 * Background saving terminated with success
    10:37:14.112 # Replica 10.4.5.12 asked for synchronization
    10:37:14.999 # Client blocked for 2100 ms waiting for reply

carmen (eng-sre): suspicious that a scheduled RDB/AOF rewrite or a backup caused blocking + replicas resync (we saw resync start times align with alert). Could also be a multi-node eviction cascade when memory pressure rose (LRU thrash).

ben (eng-runtime): Reproducer steps for the runtime team so we can confirm: 

    1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' -H "X-Request-ID: repro-123"
    2) Observe 502 after ~10s when cache gets a slow response from redis (we mock by tc qdisc delay 2s on redis port)

Attach to this thread: logs/gateway/2026-03-15/10:40:00.log (snippet): 

    [10:40:01] request_id=repro-123 route=/v1/generate upstream=redis-primary-01:6379 status=502 error="upstream read timeout"

emily (customer): we just had ~30% of our calls fail, this is high impact for our users. Any ETA?

alice (support): apologized and gave them a short mitigation note. told them we will follow up after we stabilize.

david (oncall): mitigation in progress: 

    - cache.read_through disabled for hosted-inference (rolled)
    - gateway upstream timeout increased to 20s (rolled)
    - restarted one problematic redis replica to speed resync (careful step)

carmen (eng-sre): after bypassing cache we see error-rate drop ~80% and overall request latency improves. Still monitoring memory and resync churn. Next step is to add circuit-breaker on cache calls and enforce per-key TTLs to avoid eviction cascades.

ben (eng-runtime): long-term fixes: 

    - Add per-route cache circuit-breaker (fail-open after X failures)
    - Implement local in-process LRU for hot prefixes to reduce cold pressure on redis
    - Harden redis maintenance runbooks to run without blocking clients (use non-blocking rewrite, tune save patterns)

alice (support): action items for follow-up: 

    - carmen to own incident ticket and postmortem (SLO impact, timeline, RCA)
    - ben to open runtime PR for circuit-breaker + quick config defaults
    - david to add runbook step to avoid in-place restart during resync windows
    - alice to send update to affected customers when we have RCA

carmen (eng-sre): creating incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 (will update timeline + metrics). I'm putting provisional RCA: replica resync + memory pressure -> blocking -> cache timeouts -> gateway 5xx.

ben (eng-runtime): thx — will follow up with a patch and a test that simulates resync latency.

alice (support): thanks everyone — I'll post a customer-facing update in 20m and link the ticket. :)

emily (customer): appreciate the quick updates, please keep us posted.
